_about: What each part of Keeper may use (docs/PERFORMANCE.md). 'live' is shown in Settings → Battery and speed against each running process's working set; 'ci.anonMB' is memory Keeper allocates itself, checked per part by test/e2e/perf-budget.cjs (measured 2026-11-04 on Linux with 2,000 files: main 80, windows 58, island 104, mail 31, GPU 30, helpers 32 MB; budgets leave about 40% room).
